slots.jd.charter-network.about:
Summary
Brookside Community Schools is a nonprofit charter school network committed to giving every child a strong start in reading and learning. We are seeking an Associate Teacher to work on site in Detroit alongside a lead teacher, supporting instruction and daily classroom life. Candidates must hold a current State Teaching Licence as a condition of employment.
slots.jd.charter-network.duties:
Duties
- Establish and maintain consistent classroom routines that help students start, transition and end the day calmly
- Plan daily lessons with the lead teacher, aligned to network curriculum and student needs
- Prepare for and take part in parent conferences, sharing student progress and next steps with families
- Lead small-group instruction and adapt materials for different learners
- Track student progress through classroom checks and share findings with the instructional team
- Support a safe, positive classroom culture in line with network behavior expectations
slots.jd.charter-network.needs:
Licensure and qualifications
- State Teaching Licence required
- 2 or more years of experience in an elementary classroom
- Demonstrated skill in phonics instruction and lesson planning
- Working knowledge of behavior supports and classroom management
- Clear parent communication, including regular family updates through Seesaw
- Reading Specialist Endorsement preferred
slots.r1.b1: Plans daily classroom routines through structured lesson planning, reducing instructional time lost during transitions by 50 percent.
slots.r1.b2: Records student progress and behavior in ClassDojo, sharing regular updates with the lead teacher to guide next instructional steps.
slots.r1.b3: Collaborates with grade-level colleagues to plan consistent behavior supports, contributing to a 30 percent drop in classroom disruptions.
slots.r1.b4: Adapts lessons in Nearpod for different learners, adding visuals and leveled questions so every student can take part.
slots.r1.i1: Supports the lead teacher at Oakridge Charter School in running consistent daily classroom routines for elementary students.
slots.r1.i2: Assists the lead teacher at Oakridge Charter School in tracking student progress and using classroom evidence to shape instruction.
slots.summary.1: Entry-level elementary teacher with about 2 years of classroom experience, supporting a lead teacher on a defined share of instruction under close supervision. Uses Google Classroom, formative assessment and Nearpod to deliver lessons and check student understanding.
slots.summary.2: Associate teacher with about 2 years in elementary classrooms and a B.A. in Elementary Education, working alongside a supervising teacher on selected lessons and small groups. Applies formative assessment to track learning and uses Google Classroom and Nearpod for assignments and interactive lessons.
